items.item: Correlate resource paths with Entra ID App Roles (currently DB-driven only)
items.notes: Documented in java/docs/AUTHORIZATION.md. AppRegistryService's app_registrations DB table is the sole source of authorization today; Entra ID's appid claim is used for identity only. Recommended mechanism is App Roles, not Security Groups (avoids the 200-group claim overage / extra Graph call).

items.item: Build break-glass recovery tool for total app-lockout scenarios
items.notes: Documented in java/docs/RUNBOOK.md -- no path exists today around a broken JWKS/issuer config or a wiped/corrupted app_registrations table; every recovery path currently requires the same control plane that's broken. Needs security sign-off on scope (dual-control, out-of-band from this service's own API) before building.

items.item: Execute DR restore drills (Managed HSM backup, Postgres point-in-time restore)
items.notes: Documented in java/docs/DISASTER_RECOVERY.md with the actual az CLI commands and a drill checklist. Backup mechanisms exist (Azure-native); untested restore is the real gap -- confirm retention windows and time an actual restore into a scratch environment.

items.item: Improve admin-ops tooling for grants/app-status (CLI wrapper or ticketing integration)
items.notes: Documented in java/docs/ADMIN_OPERATIONS.md. Currently hand-crafted curl calls with an ops-admin token, no approval workflow for cross-app grant changes. Also no endpoint to create a new app_registration at all -- onboarding goes through a versioned migration by design, see java/docs/APP_ONBOARDING.md.

items.item: Performance testing and capture metrics
items.notes: No load/throughput numbers exist yet for encrypt/decrypt latency, HSM unwrap call volume under concurrency, or DEK cache hit ratio under the hot-key vs. bulk patterns described in java/docs/CACHING_AND_ROTATION.md. Related to the concurrency/load test port (in progress) but distinct -- that's correctness under concurrency, this is measured throughput/latency numbers plus ongoing metrics capture (e.g. Micrometer/Actuator + a dashboard), not just pass/fail tests.

items.notes: eclipse-temurin:21-jre-jammy is full Ubuntu userland; gcr.io/distroless/java21-debian12 has no shell/package manager but also no curl, so hsm-service's Docker HEALTHCHECK would need to move to K8s-only probes

items.item: Remove apt-get from hsm-service runtime stage
items.notes: curl installed only for the Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK; resolvable by adopting a distroless base + K8s-only probes.
